## Lore

A founder's name from House [Ashgrove](../../Houses/Ashgrove.md), on the second largest of the six house moons, which run in founding order by size. Varenne would insist on that order, and Dunmere having the smallest suits its grievance. A moon of [Regane](Regane.md). These are old astronomers' names from before the Ledger, so no marks were awarded.
